searchLog: Fourth consecutive day (2026-09-04 through 2026-09-07) of total WebFetch egress blocking. Verified fresh this run: WebFetch against job-boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic/jobs and a neutral control (en.wikipedia.org) both returned EGRESS_BLOCKED; /__agentproxy/status confirms the noProxy allowlist covers only package registries and api.anthropic.com, nothing else. Per /root/.ccr/README.md this is an organization egress-policy denial to be reported, not retried or routed around. WebSearch still works and surfaced live Anthropic Applied AI Architect reqs (Startups, Public Sector, Strategic Enterprise Tech, Digital Natives Business) and other candidates, but hunt.md requires confirming open-status, eligibility, and deadline from the actual application page before including anything — categorically impossible while WebFetch is blocked. Zero opportunities written rather than padding with unverified search snippets. This is a structural, not transient, failure of the hunt step across 4 straight days; it needs the environment's egress policy widened (a job-board allowlist — Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workday, company career domains) before /hunt can produce anything again.
